unlisted_practices: Supervised finetuning and reinforcement learning on real-world tumor board discussion trajectories to adapt LLMs
Building benchmarks from real multidisciplinary tumor board recordings with expert physician review of extracted cases and consensus conclusions

screen.reason: The study introduces and evaluates LLMs on OpenTumorBoard, a real-world benchmark derived from recorded multidisciplinary tumor board discussions, measuring model performance without testing specific organizational deployment safeguards.
